details.title: Single-epoch W4 excess and radio-quiet background galaxy ambiguity
details.what_happened: Three independent review rounds confirmed the ~56-60x 22um WISE excess for Gaia DR3 4582145718700356096 from raw archive photometry, while identifying that radio_counterpart passing does not exclude the >90% radio-quiet dusty galaxy population without deep sub-arcsec optical/NIR imaging.
details.generic_lesson: Passing radio_counterpart never moves background_galaxy out of untested when deep_imaging is not_evaluated; single-epoch W4 candidates missing deep imaging or second-instrument 22um data must remain capped at Tier C.

details.title: Round 2 confirmation of single-epoch W4 Tier-C cap
details.what_happened: Round 2 adversarial review confirmed W4 excess and unresolved deep_imaging hole.
details.generic_lesson: Same generic check L001: Tier capped at C while deep_imaging or second_instrument is not_evaluated.

details.title: Round 3 confirmation of single-epoch W4 Tier-C cap
details.what_happened: Round 3 independent model family review confirmed W4 excess and human checklist over not_evaluated rows.
details.generic_lesson: Same generic check L001: human checklist explicitly flags deep_imaging and second_instrument.

details.title: Missing historical plate record must not default to J2016 coordinates in vanishing channel
details.what_happened: During live single-star inspection of high-proper-motion halo dwarf Gaia DR3 5628404318169472 (v_tan=114.6 km/s) with empty vanishing_data, VanishingChannel.measure defaulted usno_ra_deg/usno_dec_deg to J2016 Gaia coordinates and early_plates_count to 2 while back-propagating proper motion to 1953.4, producing a synthetic 6.53 arcsec mismatch and false vanishing trigger.
details.generic_lesson: Channels comparing multi-epoch catalogs must never substitute modern coordinates for absent historical epoch measurements or assume non-zero plate counts when archival plate data are missing.

details.title: Prevent synthetic noise leakage, W4 upper-limit leakage, and optimistic Gaia RVS binary clearance
details.what_happened: An adversarial audit identified four pipeline weaknesses: (1) generic_outlier injected random Gaussian noise when lightcurves/spectra/vanishing_data were absent, producing phantom open holes and retaining metal-poor halo subdwarf Gaia DR3 1111149103659931264 at Tier C; (2) live sample ingest allowed W4='U' upper limits (w4mpro_error IS NULL) to flood ir_excess flags; (3) _row_to_star_dict compared unpropagated 2016 Gaia vs 2010 WISE coords (0.58 arcsec drift); and (4) Gaia DR3 radial_velocity_error (median uncertainty) was treated as epoch scatter on faint rv_method_used=2 stars without rv_chisq_pvalue.
details.generic_lesson: Use deterministic 0.0 for absent modalities in generic_outlier, run metallicity/evolved checks on all generic_outlier stars, require w4mpro_error IS NOT NULL in live excess searches, propagate proper motion before centroid offsets, and convert median RV uncertainty via sqrt(2N/pi) (marking faint unconstrained Gaia RVS stars as binary=not_evaluated).

details.title: Scope metallicity away from IR channels, route all WISE outliers, enforce L1b/cc_flags/w4nm quality, and enable southern DECam ls_dr10
details.what_happened: Adversarial audit of 7,800-star survey exposed four pipeline leaks: (1) metallicity=fail masked ir_excess on Halo Batch 4 star 6739572937544816000 in fusion; (2) generic_outlier targets driven by ks_w3/w3_w4 (LMC star 4651844963414920576) bypassed IR vetting; (3) L1b single-exposure upper-limit frames without w4sigmpro inflated single_frames consistency and low w4nm/w4m or hh00 W1/W2 halos passed wise_quality (1598166882848977024, 6739572937544816000); (4) ls_dr10 deep imaging was gated to Dec > -30 deg and sent JSON format to DataLab.
details.generic_lesson: Scope metallicity explanations strictly away from ir_excess/ir_timedomain, route all WISE-driven generic_outlier leads through run_ir_vetting, require detected L1b sigmas/w4nm fraction and clean 4-band cc_flags, and query DECam ls_dr10.tractor via CSV across all southern sky fields.

details.title: Fetch TESS QLP/TESScut, ZTF and ASAS-SN live for LC vetting, with matched detrending and retried/paged ZTF queries
details.what_happened: The sole Tier C survivor 5628404318169472 carried two not_evaluated holes that code could close. pipeline_agreement never received a second TESS extraction because live enrichment fetched no TESS data, and the adversarial review's hand comparison of QLP vs. TESScut (raw r = 0.43-0.81) used different detrending on each series. second_survey never received ZTF or ASAS-SN because live enrichment had no optical survey fetch, and the reviewer's own IRSA ZTF cone requests timed out at 40 s unless narrowed to one band list and a 6 arcsec cone.
details.generic_lesson: A cross-pipeline comparison is only meaningful when both series go through the identical detrending filter at matched cadences, using the detection channel's own window. Archive time-series queries that can time out need bounded retries, a shrinking cone and time-window paging, and every failure mode must surface in the check note instead of silently reading as no coverage. Vetting-only time series are stored apart from channel inputs so new vetting data never changes a certified channel score.

details.title: Vetting checks passed on default input values when no archive query had run
details.what_happened: Before commits 7d3702f (infrared) and 0e5956a (light curve), live enrichment filled vetting inputs with benign defaults when no archive query supplied them (for example n_neighbours_gaia_xmatch=1, cirrus_bg_rms_mjy=0.4, galex_uv_excess_mag=0.0, xray_luminosity_erg_s=0.0, rv_scatter_kms=0.3, nss_flag=0), and several light-curve checks read fixture-only flags. Checks then reported pass on those defaults, so a pass row did not show that the archive had been queried. This applied to the live candidates, including 5628404318169472.
details.generic_lesson: A vetting check may report pass or fail only from data that a recorded query returned. Live enrichment records the outcome of every query in vetting_archive.query_status; when the query did not run or failed, the check reports not_evaluated and names the missing query, and a stale input value is not used.
details.automated_check: vetting_archive.query_status rule in oddstar.vet.ir_checks and oddstar.vet.lc_checks (missing or failed query -> not_evaluated)

details.title: Evidence behind vetting passes was not stored in the repository
details.what_happened: Registry ledger entries recorded tier and check status, but the per-check notes, metrics, consumed manifest IDs / SHA-256 values / query URLs and images that supported each pass lived only under the git-ignored runs/ and dossiers/ directories. A pass row in the ledger could therefore not be checked from a clone of the repository. The registrations made before the evidence store (including 5628404318169472) remain without committed evidence and are reported as legacy_without_evidence.
details.generic_lesson: Every registration commits a compact, size-guarded evidence directory (registry/evidence/<source_id>/<run_id>/) with an index of file SHA-256 values, and the ledger entry references the directory and the index SHA-256. CI verifies the hashes and that every pass/fail row has its evidence file; entries without evidence are counted, not hidden.
